searchText: Hey there, after grandine facing OOM killed and CPU overload during syncing, I want to check with other clients how you implement block acceptance in the fork choice. Do we require to have all sampling columns to be available to consider whether to accept the block or we can just accept the block then backfill those columns instead? With the current spec, all custody & sampling columns are required before we import the block. how is LH perform during syncing with columns? We still have a few sync bugs, but we're not noticing any resource issues during sync Yeah, for Grandine we still need to optimize the request loads (redundant) due to delay block acceptance, leading to resource overload They were done manually, this was the first time and we didn't really know what we were looking for. So manual was the way to go. No real reason to not script them at this point, besides the ability to ensure the network is truly healthy before starting the next experiment Reminder: PeerDAS breakout call is on today <t:1741687200:R> https://github.com/ethereum/pm/issues/1326 I will not be able to attend today. Lodestar update is we got nearly complete with a refactor and started looking validator custody. <@792822129019584562> put up a PR to simplify the validator custody implementation and would love everyone’s feedback on that. Will look at implementing validator custody fully after a round of feedback on that PR to get a sense of the direction we should take. Note, 13/21 of the nodes on the peerdas-devnet-5 network are now full nodes. This is ~61% of the network, a distribution we expect to see on mainnet as well. look for the variable: `ethereum_node_cl_supernode_enabled=False` in this file: https://github.com/ethpandaops/peerdas-devnets/blob/master/ansible/inventories/devnet-5/inventory.ini Or if you're a visual person: https://dora.peerdas-devnet-5.ethpandaops.io/clients/consensus (toggle "Supernode peers" to show just full node peers) we do have an ask though: Dora just fetches the full node peers based on the enr. Is there some way we can verify that nodes are indeed configured to be full nodes? And if so, can each client dev please check their nodes and report back so we don't have bugs? call is on now! Thanks for joining the call today!  Summary:
- CL teams are continuing to make progress on various fixes and validator custody, with some help from external teams (Base) 🔨  
- Gajinder proposed a spec change to simplify validator custody, and teams should review and provide feedback ASAP. 👀  
- We had some EL representatives on the call to discuss spec changes. 🔥  
- Geth, Nethermind, and EthereumJS will participate in devnet-6. 🚀  
- **Teams should review the network wrapper change and aim to finalize it in the next 2 days** so that all CL/EL teams can start implementation.🏃
- Devnet-5 is running well with full nodes; CL teams should verify that the nodes are indeed set up as full nodes.  
- ethPandaOps will start introducing some chaos into devnet-5.
- Francis from Base created a roadmap document (to replace the readiness checklist). Please review and help update it: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1MXf5zTU58mRj0Yq88EPBP1gCJzWTY9FRfUdpZjcfgqw/edit?tab=t.0  
- **The next breakout call will be on Tuesday at 1400 UTC!**

Notes:

Hello everyone! 
I'm Minhyuk from Sunnyside Labs, and we're currently working on running devnets and tests to help with the shipping of peerdas 🙂 

In the past week, we started running our first devnet test, which was aimed at testing high blob throughput in a controlled network to identify any issues in clients when handling high blob counts(>40).

I'd love to get your comments and thoughts on them. Please let us know what sort of metrics or test scenarios that you'd like to see in the future devnets regarding peerdas and blob usages!
https://testinprod.notion.site/Sunnyside-Devnet-Updates-03-11-1b38fc57f54680d8a35dfa4cfb8b852c

In the result of this devnet, we noticed few findings for `reth`, `besu` and `lodestar`. What would be the best way to get in touch with the corresponding client team regarding these inquiries?
